images.name: 06-keepalive-filter.png
images.evidence: The visible green filter bar contains tcp.analysis.keep_alive || tcp.analysis.keep_alive_ack. Eight displayed frames—25, 26, 39, 40, 44, 45, 49 and 50—show alternating TCP Keep-Alive and TCP Keep-Alive ACK Info labels in opposite directions between 192.0.2.10 and 203.0.113.40. The status bar confirms 65 packets and 8 displayed.

images.name: 07-existing-connection.png
images.evidence: The visible tcp.stream == 2 filter displays 17 frames. Frames 16–18 show the handshake, frames 19–21 show payload exchange and acknowledgment, frames 25/26, 39/40, 44/45 and 49/50 show four keep-alive probe/ACK pairs, and frames 54–56 show FIN/ACK closure. Addresses and ports remain consistent across this visible connection.

images.name: 08-probe-details.png
images.evidence: The packet dialog visibly identifies frame 25 as 54 bytes, with IPv4 source 192.0.2.10 and destination 203.0.113.40. Its collapsed TCP summary shows source port 43001, destination port 9000, Seq=11, Ack=10 and Len=0. The bottom packet summary explicitly shows time 51.000000000 and [TCP Keep-Alive]. This satisfies the bounded summary/Info role without requiring hidden expanded TCP fields.
